name: ResMed
description: ResMed makes CPAP and bilevel machines and the masks, tubing and accessories that go with them for sleep apnea and respiratory care, and cloud software for care providers. About 88 percent of sales is sleep and breathing health: the device is sold once, but masks and accessories are replaced regularly and make up 42 percent of that segment, so installed patients generate recurring revenue. The other 12 percent is software (MatrixCare, Brightree, MEDIFOX DAN) sold to home-medical-equipment suppliers, nursing homes and home health agencies. GAAP gross margin is 61 percent.

employees.note: 31 percent in the Americas, 31 percent Asia, 15 percent Australia, 23 percent Europe
